@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_max_usages_from_order(event, customer, membership, membership_type,
                                                             requiring_ticket):
    membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership_type.save()
    order = event.orders.create(
        code='MEMB1', email='dummy@example.org', status=Order.STATUS_PAID, total=Decimal('23.00'),
        datetime=now(), expires=now() + timedelta(days=10), locale='en', customer=customer,
        sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
    )
    OrderPosition.objects.create(
        order=order, item=requiring_ticket, price=Decimal('23.00'), positionid=1, used_membership=membership,
    )
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    # The order being changed must not count against its own membership usage
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, ignored_order=order)
